title: Judge Verdict
description: Generic binary verdict returned by an external judge for a 'verify' or 'plan-critique' JudgeRequest (architecture §6, Phase 8): does this provider agree with the native claim under judgment (a blocking finding, an epic-final verdict, ...)? A 'review' JudgeRequest validates against finding.schema.json instead (an array of findings), not this schema. `verdict` is a plain structural enum, not a taxonomy dimension — it describes a judge's agree/disagree stance, not a controlled-vocabulary tag (architecture §8 draws that line at classification fields only).
